title: T-010 Jarvis staging access audit
summary: Jarvis has an isolated staging account, clone, and sanitized database copy. Private app repository access, verified board write access, and the retrieval side indexes are still missing.
evidence: PASS: Jarvis signs in to staging with a dedicated key. Password and root login are disabled.
PASS: Jarvis has no administrative privileges.
PASS: Jarvis's local application clone is on the assigned retrieval branch, and the retrieval module is present.

PASS: Jarvis's sanitized database copy is readable only by Jarvis. It matches the canonical checksum, holds 26,559 content chunks, and has no users, questions, feedback, testers, clicks, or referral contact details.
PASS: No production credential, known host, or SSH route exists in Jarvis's profile.
FAIL: Jarvis has no credential for the private application repository.
FAIL: The board write key is registered but is not installed on the staging host. It has not been verified from Jarvis's own session.
FAIL: The board write key has repository-wide scope and cannot be limited to Jarvis's branch.
FAIL: The FTS5 and vector side indexes have not been built, so the side-index schema and row counts are not available.
limitations: This is a host-side audit by the orchestrator account. Jarvis has not yet run a self-test from Jarvis's own session. No changes were made.
